preregistration: Declared before any index number or fit was computed (analysis/index_precision_PREREG.md, 2026-09-29). Cell = (benchmark, split, retriever, KG condition != OpenIE). Outcome = hit@5(condition) - hit@5(OpenIE), same retriever/split/questions, from frozen per-question vectors. PRIMARY predictor dF1 = mean_q F1_q(condition) - mean_q F1_q(OpenIE), where F1_q is the harmonic mean of index precision P_q=|L_q&G_q|/|L_q| (0 if L_q empty) and recall R_q=|L_q&G_q|/|G_q| over L_q = corpus passages linked from the nodes the retriever's own matcher returns for q. PRIMARY test = Spearman rho(dF1, gain) pooled over all cells of the three retrievers, 95% CI by two-stage cluster bootstrap (benchmarks, then questions within benchmark-split), B=2000. Everything else is secondary.
